title: Protein Quantification by SDS-PAGE and Coomassie Staining
author: Sarah van Veen
materials: Analyze protein band intensities using ImageJ software ( http://fiji.sc ; RRID:SCR_002285).
Capture an image of the stained gel using an ordinary scanner or Bio-Rad ChemiDoc MP imaging system.

steps.title: Prepare BSA Standards
steps.instruction: Prepare BSA standards with 4 µL LDS sample loading buffer (supplemented with β-mercaptoethanol) at the following concentrations: 12 µL of 0.01 mg/ml, 0.02 mg/ml, 0.04 mg/ml, 0.08 mg/ml, and 0.1 mg/ml.

steps.title: Prepare Protein Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare 12 µL of protein samples with 4 µL LDS sample loading buffer (supplemented with β-mercaptoethanol).

steps.title: Load Gel
steps.instruction: Load the prepared standards, protein samples, and molecular weight markers onto a precast NuPAGE 4-12% BisTris gel.

steps.title: Run Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the gel using MOPS running buffer at 170 V for 01:00:00 at room temperature.

steps.title: Stain Gel
steps.instruction: Stain the gel with Coomassie for approximately 01:00:00 or until bands are clearly visible.

steps.title: Generate Standard Curve
steps.instruction: Plot the intensity of the BSA bands as a function of protein concentration to generate a standard curve.

steps.title: Quantify Protein Concentration
steps.instruction: Calculate the concentration of the protein of interest by comparing its band intensity to the standard curve, ensuring the sample falls within the linear range of the curve.

description: Destain the gel using distilled water until the background is clear and bands are distinct.
